scope: Fresh free-text evidence requests for a paired browser-release comparison. The previously reviewed ten questions and Article 20 preset cases are excluded.

queries.query: Satellite maps of nighttime land surface temperature in European cities
queries.intent: Find a gridded satellite product that measures land surface temperature at night and covers European cities. Daytime-only products and air temperature are separate measurements. An urban heat map with unclear time of day can supply partial evidence.

queries.query: Monthly satellite sea surface salinity in the North Atlantic
queries.intent: Find satellite-derived surface salinity measurements with North Atlantic coverage and monthly sampling or aggregation. Gridded satellite salinity at a different cadence can be useful if monthly estimates can be calculated from it.

queries.query: Global satellite leaf area index time series
queries.intent: Find a global satellite collection with repeated leaf area index measurements. Vegetation indices, fraction of cover and chlorophyll are separate variables that can provide context.

queries.query: Satellite maps of land burned by wildfires in Australia
queries.intent: Find mapped burned-area observations covering Australia. Active-fire detections, fire danger and smoke products measure different quantities. A suitable proxy or a map covering only part of Australia can provide useful partial evidence.

queries.query: Fluorescence microscopy images of human retinal tissue sections
queries.intent: The requested observation is a microscopy image of a human retinal tissue section. A reference to fluorescence, imaging or a spectral band alone does not establish relevance.

queries.query: Farm projects that use satellite soil moisture to schedule irrigation
queries.intent: Find a research project that uses or tests satellite-derived soil moisture for deciding when or how much to irrigate. A farm irrigation study using only in-situ moisture sensing, or a satellite soil moisture project with no irrigation application, can provide useful partial evidence.

queries.query: Using satellite radar interferometry to monitor land subsidence
queries.intent: Find a research project applying or testing satellite radar interferometry for ground subsidence. Satellite radar deformation methods validated on a different related phenomenon can provide partial evidence if the method is transferable.

queries.query: Projects testing infrared thermography to measure heat loss from buildings
queries.intent: Find a project using thermal infrared images to assess heat loss through building envelopes. Building energy work without thermal measurement or imaging offers a weaker connection. Thermography applied to comparable thermal leakage can provide useful partial evidence.

queries.query: Field trials of nitrogen dioxide air quality sensors in European cities
queries.intent: Find a research project that deploys or validates devices measuring nitrogen dioxide in an urban European setting. Other air pollutants or laboratory-only sensor testing can count as partial if the instrumentation is transferable.

queries.query: Live Madrid Atocha commuter train departures today
queries.intent: The requested answer requires a live station departure feed for Madrid Atocha. Railway grants, published transport research and references to Madrid alone do not supply current departures.
